caption: The drawing is rendered in black ink on a beige or light brownish background and depicts a detailed technical plan of a side chair. There are three primary labeled views: the “Front Elevation,” showing the front of the chair with turned legs, ornate scrollwork on the uprights, a rectangular seat, and a decorative tall back with a shaded area labeled “Cane Back”; the “Side Elevation,” showing the chair's profile with similar ornate details, cane paneling, and a cushion drawn on the seat; and the “Plan,” which shows the seat from above, marked with areas labeled “Cane Seat” and “Cushion.” Dimensions are provided: the chair is 49½ inches tall, 17⅞ inches wide at the front, 13⅞ inches wide at the back, 14¾ inches deep, and 16 inches from front to back on the seat. The upper-right corner includes a close-up of the decorative scrollwork that forms the crest of the chair’s back. Labels specify the materials: “Side Chair, Maple, With Cane Back & Seat,” and cite the “Met. Museum American Wing.” The scale at the bottom indicates "1 1/2"=1'-0"." Thin straight lines indicate measurement guides, and the entire composition is organized with precise, technical linework suited for architectural or furniture design documentation.
title: Side Chair, with Cane Back and Seat
